notes: Anthropic and OpenAI rates verified against both published pricing pages in `sources` on 2026-09-25.

cacheMultipliers is keyed by provider: Anthropic charges a premium to WRITE the cache (1.25x for the 5-minute TTL, 2x for the hour) and reads at 0.1x. A model may override its vendor's terms via its own `cache` block, because neither vendor is internally uniform.
Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 read cache at 0.025x ($0.25/MTok), not 0.1x. Cache reads are ~95% of local token volume, so applying the vendor default to them is a 4x overcharge on almost the whole bill.
Opus 5.5 reads cache at 0.05x ($0.20/MTok), not 0.1x. Same trap as Fable 5.1, half the size: the vendor default would overcharge it 2x on ~95% of the bill.
Sonnet 5 is $2/$10. The increase to $3/$15 scheduled for 2026-09-01 was cancelled and the launch price made permanent.

Opus 5.5 is a new tier BELOW Opus 5, at $4/$20 against $5/$25, and is cheaper on cache reads too (0.05x against 0.10x). It undercuts the model above it on every axis, so a same-tier peer suggestion that still points at an older Opus is quoting the more expensive model.

GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna (launched 2026-09-23) undercut the GPT-5.6 models at the same tier: Sol is exactly half Sol 5.6 ($2/$10 against $4/$20), and Luna is half on input and less than half on output ($0.10/$0.50 against $0.20/$1.20). Any tier-downshift figure computed before these rows existed was measured against a floor roughly 2x too high.
GPT-5.6 Sol's $4/$20 is PROMOTIONAL and guaranteed only through 2026-11-21. Re-check it after that date.

PARTIALLY MODELLED: OpenAI publishes a long-context tier for every GPT-5.6 and GPT-6 model here — 2x input, 2x cached input, 2x cache write and 1.5x output once a request crosses the long-context prompt threshold, applied to the WHOLE request and not just the tokens above it. Only gpt-6-astra carries a `longContext` block (threshold 272000), so only it bills correctly on a very large prompt; the other five OpenAI rows are still short-context-only and under-bill above their thresholds. Adding each one needs its published threshold, not just a copy of Astra's.

models.why: Cache hits bill at $0.25/MTok, a quarter of the 0.1x vendor default.
Same terms as Fable 5.1. Limited availability (Project Glasswing).

A new tier BELOW Opus 5, not above it: $4/$20 against $5/$25, and cache hits at 0.05x ($0.20/MTok) against 0.10x ($0.50/MTok). Cheaper than the model above it on every axis. The 0.05x read is the reason for the override. The vendor default would overcharge it 2x on the ~95% of local volume that is cache reads.
Published at $5/$25. Previously carried in unknownModels at "unknown" confidence, which flagged the largest single slice of local usage as unrecognized even though the assumed price was right.
$2/$10. The $3/$15 increase scheduled for 2026-09-01 was cancelled and the launch price made permanent.

Published at $10 input, $1.00 cached input (0.1x), $12.50 cache write (1.25x), $50 output. The flagship of the GPT-6 line and the only one of the three that is not cheaper than its GPT-5.6 counterpart.

Published at $2 input, $0.20 cached input (0.1x), $2.50 cache write (1.25x), $10 output, exactly half Sol 5.6 at the same tier. Note it also undercuts the mid-tier GPT-5.6 Terra ($2/$12) on output while sitting a tier above it, so a downshift away from it saves nothing.
Published at $0.10 input, $0.01 cached input (0.1x), $0.125 cache write (1.25x), $0.50 output. Half Luna 5.6 on input and less than half on output ($0.50 against $1.20).
Promotional rate, guaranteed by OpenAI only through 2026-11-21. Re-check after that date. GPT-6 Sol is now half this price at the same tier.
